programs.title: Bubble's Hotel
programs.sub_title: The Royal Staff/Having a Ball/1000 Flavours/Swirlina's Meltdown
programs.desc: When the Queen of Hearts comes to stay at the hotel, Bubble is so intimidated that she starts making mistakes - like losing the Queen's royal staff! /  The hotel's ice cream-maker goes berserk, Bubble and Nabi must put a stop to it.

programs.title: Beyblade Burst Quadstrike
programs.desc: Training at the battle camp is not letting up, and some Bladers have more trouble following Wakiya's rules than others. Exhibit A through Z: Bel goes off script, declaring a rematch with his new rival Hyuga.

programs.title: Beyblade X
programs.desc: Multi Nanairo of Team Persona returns from her Beycraft training at the Animal Castle with a full heart. While Reiyu tries to cast a curse on her, Multi shows her a new Bey and smiles at her wryly. After the training, Multi has regained her self-confidence and has found the answer to why she wants to make Beyblades. Then comes the decisive battle, in which one defeat will determine Persona's defeat. The battle between the knight and the ghost reaches its climax while the Manju Family watches Multi through a live broadcast of the battle!

programs.title: LEGO City Adventures
programs.desc: The Mayor and Carol work late when strange events happen in 'Small Carol', then in 'Last Man Floating', Extreme Sports host Dynamo holds a competition to see who'll go on the Mars mission.

programs.title: Barbie: Dreamhouse Adventures
programs.desc: Barbie and her friends try to wow Nikki's fashion idol at a mermaid convention.

programs.title: Smashhdown! - Search For The G.O.A.T
programs.desc: Author's Week continues as we embark on an epic tale of ferocious competition. Which of these remarkable writers will have the penmanship to flip past their opponent and ink a winning chapter today?
